title: Nine of twelve sampled BART purchases had fewer than three quotes

beats.text: How many suppliers actually quoted a price when BART bought inventory?

visual.sub: Nine of twelve transactions had fewer than three quotes

beats.text: Nine of 12 purchases had fewer than three quotes.
Staff cited a limited supplier pool and specialized requirements.

visual.kicker: Nine of twelve transactions had fewer than three quotes

beats.text: A different sample tested 38 procurement files.

visual.label: The documented approval often followed notification of the selected supplier

beats.text: For the records checked online, the supplier already knew it had won before order approval.
Auditors also compared 20 card purchases to the stock list.

visual.kicker: A separate card-purchase sample found overlap with listed stock

beats.text: They could classify 17 purchases. 13 were for types of items already listed.

visual.label: A separate card-purchase sample found overlap with listed stock

beats.text: Managers said some listed tools were no longer tracked as inventory.

visual.line: Stock list and tool policy differed

beats.text: The district agreed to strengthen supplier outreach and prior review.

visual.kicker: The supplier-directory and prior-review changes remained in progress

beats.text: In November 2026, both actions were still in progress.
The sample shows a control gap. It gives no measured overpayment.
